blocks.text: Kelajak: bitta zamon emas, o'nlab usul

O'zbek tilida kelajak ko'pincha bitta shakl bilan aytiladi: «ertaga **boraman**», «poyezd soat oltida **jo'naydi**», «**bormoqchiman**». Ingliz tilida esa «Future tense» degan yagona zamon yo'q: shakl kelajakdagi voqeaning o'zi bilan emas, **siz unga qanday qarashingiz** bilan tanlanadi. Bu reja mi yoki shu paytdagi qaror? Jadval bo'yicha bo'ladimi yoki taxmin qilyapsizmi? Kelajakdagi paytda davom etadimi yoki o'sha paytgacha tugaydimi? Bu ilova 19–25-darslarda alohida o'tilgan barcha shakllarni yonma-yon qo'yadi va qaysi birini qachon tanlashni ko'rsatadi.

rows: kelishilgan reja: vaqt, joy, odamlar belgilangan
I**'m seeing** the dentist at four.
oldindan qilingan niyat; ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab bashorat
I**'m going to learn** Korean. / It**'s going to rain**.
shu paytda qabul qilingan qaror, taklif, va'da; fikrga asoslangan bashorat
I**'ll get** it. / You**'ll love** Khiva.
kelajakdagi paytda davom etayotgan harakat; odatdagidek bo'ladigan ish
The plane **is due to land** at six.

blocks.text: Reja va qaror: will, going to yoki Present Continuous?

Uchala shakl ham «ertaga Samarqandga boraman» ni tarjima qila oladi. Farq — qaror **qachon** qabul qilingani va u **qanchalik tayyor** ekanida. **will** — qaror hozir, gapirayotgan paytda tug'ildi. **be going to** — qaror oldin qabul qilingan, bu niyat. **Present Continuous** — qaror oldin qabul qilingan va reja kelishilgan: chipta olingan, uchrashuv belgilangan (→ 19, 20, 23-darslar).

rows: I'm thirsty. — Wait, I**'ll get** you some water.
I**'m going to buy** a new laptop next month.
Oldin qaror qilganman va kelishib qo'yganman
I**'m picking** Aziz up from the airport at six.

items.text: We've run out of bread. — Have we? I**'ll buy** some on my way home.
items.translation: Nonimiz tugabdi. — Shundaymi? Uyga qaytayotib **olib kelaman**.

items.text: I**'m going to repaint** my room this summer — I just need to choose a colour.
items.translation: Bu yoz xonamni qayta **bo'yamoqchiman** — faqat rangini tanlashim kerak.

items.text: Malika **is starting** her new job on Monday.

blocks.text: Kelajakni taxmin qilganda ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin, lekin asosi boshqacha. **will** — fikr, ishonch, tajriba: I think / I'm sure / probably bilan. **be going to** — hozirgi belgi: «ko'rinib turibdi, hademay shunday bo'ladi». Qora bulutlarni ko'rib turib — It**'s going to rain**; ob-havo haqida umumiy fikr — I think it**'ll rain** tomorrow.

items.text: I'm sure you**'ll enjoy** the trip to the Aral Sea.
Be careful — you**'re going to spill** your tea!
Experts say the population **will reach** forty million soon.
items.translation: Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, aholi soni tez orada qirq millionga **yetadi**.

blocks.text: Jadval va rasmiy reja: Present Simple, be due to, be to

Poyezd, samolyot, dars, kino, konferensiya — shaxsiy xohishga bog'liq bo'lmagan, jadvalda yozilgan voqealar uchun **Present Simple**: The train **leaves** at 6.40. **be due to** — «jadvalga ko'ra kutilmoqda»: The report **is due to be** published in May. **be to** — rasmiy, ko'pincha yangiliklarda: The minister **is to resign**. Inkor shakli **be not to** esa buyruq yoki taqiq bildiradi: You **are not to leave** the building.
will be doing, will have done, will have been doing

rows: At ten tomorrow I**'ll be sitting** an exam.
By noon I**'ll have finished** it.
o'sha paytgacha qancha vaqt davom etgani
In June I**'ll have been living** here for a year.

items.text: Don't call at eight — I**'ll be driving** home then.
items.translation: Soat sakkizda qo'ng'iroq qilma — o'shanda uyga **mashina haydab ketayotgan bo'laman**.

items.text: By the time we arrive, the shops **will have closed**.
**Will** you **be passing** a chemist's on your way back?

blocks.text: Ergash gaplarda will yo'q: when I get, as soon as I've finished

when, as soon as, before, after, until, once, if, unless, in case dan keyin kelajak ma'nosida **Present Simple** yoki **Present Perfect** ishlatiladi, **will** emas (→ 25-dars). Bu o'zbekchaga o'xshaydi: «uyga **kelsam**», «**tugatganimdan keyin**» — bu shakllarda ham kelasi zamon qo'shimchasi yo'q. Istisno: **if** «-mi, yo'qmi» ma'nosida (= whether) bo'lsa, will qo'yiladi.

rows: I don't know if he **will come**.
Hurry, the shop **is about to close**.
be bound to / be sure to / will certainly
She**'s bound to win** — she's the best.

blocks.text: O'tmishdagi bir paytdan kelajakka qarasak, shakllar «orqaga suriladi»: am going to → **was going to**, will → **would**, is about to → **was about to**, am meeting → **was meeting**. Ko'pincha amalga oshmagan rejalar haqida: I **was going to call** you, but I forgot — Senga qo'ng'iroq **qilmoqchi edim**, lekin esimdan chiqibdi. O'zbekchada «-moqchi edim», «-adigan edi», «-ishi kerak edi».

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I will call you when I will arrive.» → when I **arrive**; «I'm going to answer it!» (telefon hozir jiringladi) → I**'ll** answer it (qaror hozir); «I will meet Sardor tomorrow at six, we agreed.» → I**'m meeting** Sardor (kelishilgan reja); «Will I open the window?» (taklif) → **Shall** I open the window?; «Tomorrow I go to Bukhara.» (shaxsiy reja) → I**'m going** to Bukhara tomorrow (Present Simple faqat jadval uchun); «By Friday I will finish.» → I **will have finished** («...gacha tugatib bo'laman»).

Tez tanlash: jadvalda yozilganmi? → Present Simple. Kelishib qo'yilganmi? → Present Continuous. Niyatmi yoki ko'rinib turgan belgimi? → going to. Hozir qaror qildingizmi, taklif yoki va'da qilyapsizmi, fikr bildiryapsizmi? → will. Kelajakdagi paytda «o'rtasida» bo'lasizmi? → will be doing; «...gacha» tugaydimi? → will have done.

Bog'liq darslar: → 19-dars (Present tenses for the future), 20 (going to), 21–22 (will / shall), 23 (will va going to), 24 (will be doing / will have done), 25 (when I do / when I've done), 29–30 (may / might); asoslari → qizil kitob, 25–29-darslar.

rows: It**'s going to fall**. / I think it**'ll be** fine.

examples.title: Plans: **I'm meeting** and **I'm going to meet**
examples.description: Present Continuous — boshqalar bilan kelishilgan, vaqti va joyi belgilangan reja; be going to — oldindan qilingan niyat, hali kelishilmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: I**'m meeting** the bank manager at ten tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat o'nda bank boshqaruvchisi bilan **uchrashaman**, shuning uchun bolalarni maktabga olib bora olmayman.

sentences.text: We**'re flying** to Urgench on Friday — the tickets are already booked.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Urganchga **uchamiz** — chiptalar allaqachon band qilingan.

sentences.text: What **are** you **doing** this weekend? — Nothing special, why?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari nima **qilasiz**? — Hech narsa, nimaydi?

sentences.text: Kamron **is going to apply** for a master's degree in Germany next year.
sentences.translation: Kamron kelasi yili Germaniyada magistraturaga hujjat **topshirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: I**'m going to paint** the kitchen yellow, but I haven't bought the paint yet.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani sariq rangga **bo'yamoqchiman**, lekin hali bo'yoq sotib olmadim.

sentences.text: My sister **is getting** married in June, and the whole family is coming from Khorezm.
sentences.translation: Opam iyunda **turmushga chiqyapti**, butun oila Xorazmdan keladi.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to tell** your boss about the mistake, or will you just fix it?
sentences.translation: Xato haqida boshlig'ingga **aytmoqchimisan** yoki shunchaki tuzatib qo'yasanmi?

sentences.text: Sherzod **isn't coming** to the meeting because he's got a dentist's appointment.
sentences.translation: Sherzod majlisga **kelmaydi**, chunki tish shifokori qabuliga yozilgan.

sentences.text: This summer we**'re going to spend** less money and save up for a car.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz kamroq pul **sarflab**, mashinaga pul **yig'moqchimiz**.

sentences.text: Who **are** you **having** lunch with on Thursday? — A client from Dubai.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni kim bilan tushlik **qilasiz**? — Dubaylik bir mijoz bilan.

examples.title: Decisions, offers, promises: **I'll**, **Shall I**, **won't**
examples.description: will — gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, taklif, va'da; won't — «ko'nmaydi, istamaydi» ma'nosi ham bor. Shall I / Shall we — taklif qilish yoki maslahat so'rash.

sentences.text: Someone's knocking at the door. — Stay where you are, I**'ll get** it.
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni taqillatyapti. — O'tiravering, men **ochaman**.

sentences.text: These bags look really heavy. **Shall I carry** one of them for you?
sentences.translation: Bu sumkalar juda og'irga o'xshaydi. Bittasini **ko'tarishib yuboraymi**?

sentences.text: I promise I **won't tell** anyone what you told me today.
sentences.translation: Bugun aytganlaringni hech kimga **aytmayman**, va'da beraman.

sentences.text: The car **won't start** again — I think the battery is dead.
sentences.translation: Mashina yana **o't olmayapti** — akkumulyator o'tirib qolgan shekilli.

sentences.text: Oh no, I've left my wallet at home! — Never mind, I**'ll lend** you some money.
sentences.translation: Voy, hamyonimni uyda qoldiribman! — Hechqisi yo'q, men senga qarz **berib turaman**.

sentences.text: Where **shall we** go for dinner tonight — Uzbek or Italian?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqatga qayerga **boraylik** — o'zbek oshxonasigami yoki italyangami?

sentences.text: I think I**'ll have** the lamb shashlik and a pot of green tea.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, qo'y go'shtidan shashlik va bir choynak ko'k choy **olaman**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the report — I**'ll finish** it before I go home.
sentences.translation: Hisobot haqida xavotir olmang — uyga ketishdan oldin **tugatib qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: My son **won't eat** vegetables, however I cook them.
sentences.translation: Sabzavotni qanday pishirsam ham, o'g'lim **yemaydi**.

sentences.text: Is it cold in here? — A bit. **Shall I close** the window?
sentences.translation: Bu yer sovuqmi? — Biroz. Derazani **yopib qo'yaymi**?

examples.title: Predictions: **will** or **going to**?
examples.description: will — fikr va ishonchga asoslangan bashorat (I think, probably, I'm sure); be going to — hozirgi belgiga qarab: «ko'rinib turibdi, hademay shunday bo'ladi».

sentences.text: Those clouds over the mountains are very dark — it**'s going to rain** any minute.
sentences.translation: Tog' ustidagi bulutlar juda qora — hozir yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: I think Uzbekistan **will qualify** for the next World Cup.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, O'zbekiston keyingi jahon chempionatiga **yo'llanma oladi**.

sentences.text: Watch out! That ladder **is going to fall**!
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'l! Narvon **yiqilib tushadi**!

sentences.text: Don't worry about the interview — you**'ll be** fine, I'm sure.
sentences.translation: Suhbat haqida xavotir olma — hammasi yaxshi **bo'ladi**, ishonaman.

sentences.text: Prices **will** probably **rise** again after the new year.
sentences.translation: Yangi yildan keyin narxlar yana **oshsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Dilfuza **is going to have** a baby in the spring.
sentences.translation: Dilfuza bahorda **farzand ko'radi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to miss** the train — it leaves in two minutes and we're still in a taxi!
sentences.translation: Poyezdga **ulgurmaymiz** — u ikki daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi, biz esa hali taksidamiz!

sentences.text: In twenty years, most cars in Tashkent **will be** electric, I imagine.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, yigirma yildan keyin Toshkentdagi mashinalarning ko'pi elektr **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: With five minutes left and a 4–0 lead, Navbahor **is going to win** this match.
sentences.translation: Besh daqiqa qoldi, hisob 4:0 — bu o'yinda Navbahor **yutadi**.

sentences.text: **Will** the shops **be** open on Navruz, do you think?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Navro'zda do'konlar ochiq **bo'ladimi**?

examples.title: Timetables and official plans: **leaves**, **is due to**, **is to**
examples.description: Present Simple — jadval, dastur, rasmiy vaqt; be due to — jadvalga ko'ra kutilmoqda; be to — rasmiy reja (yangiliklarda) yoki ko'rsatma.

sentences.text: The last metro train **leaves** Chilonzor at twenty to midnight.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi metro poyezdi Chilonzordan soat o'n ikkiga yigirma daqiqa qolganda **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: What time **does** the conference **start** on Monday? — At half past nine.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni konferensiya soat nechada **boshlanadi**? — To'qqiz yarimda.

sentences.text: Our flight **lands** in Istanbul at 6.15 local time.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz mahalliy vaqt bilan 6:15 da Istanbulga **qo'nadi**.

sentences.text: The new bridge **is due to open** in December, but few people believe it will.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik dekabrda **ochilishi kerak**, lekin bunga kam odam ishonadi.

sentences.text: Next term **begins** on 2 September, and the timetable is already online.
sentences.translation: Keyingi chorak 2-sentabrda **boshlanadi**, dars jadvali allaqachon internetda.

sentences.text: The President **is to visit** Karakalpakstan next week, the agency reported.
sentences.translation: Agentlik xabariga ko'ra, Prezident kelasi hafta Qoraqalpog'istonga **tashrif buyuradi**.

sentences.text: Her baby **is due** at the end of March.
sentences.translation: Uning chaqalog'i mart oyining oxirida **tug'ilishi kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Students **are not to use** their phones during the exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida talabalar telefondan **foydalanmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the last bus — the film **finishes** at eleven.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi avtobus haqida xavotir olma — film soat o'n birda **tugaydi**.

sentences.text: Two new metro stations **are to be built** in Yunusabad by 2028.
sentences.translation: 2028-yilgacha Yunusobodda ikkita yangi metro bekati **qurilishi rejalashtirilgan**.

examples.title: **will be doing** and **will have done**
examples.description: Future Continuous — kelajakdagi paytda davom etayotgan yoki odatdagidek bo'ladigan harakat; Future Perfect — o'sha paytgacha tugallanadi (by + vaqt); Future Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha qancha vaqt davom etgani.

sentences.text: This time next week Gulnora **will be sitting** her final exams in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta shu vaqtda Gulnora Oksfordda bitiruv imtihonlarini **topshirayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Don't phone between seven and eight — we**'ll be having** dinner.
sentences.translation: Yettidan sakkizgacha qo'ng'iroq qilmang — **kechki ovqat qilayotgan bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: **Will** you **be using** your car on Saturday? I need to move some furniture.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni mashinangizdan **foydalanasizmi**? Bir oz mebel tashishim kerak edi.

sentences.text: By the end of the year, we**'ll have paid** off the mortgage.
sentences.translation: Yil oxirigacha ipotekani **to'lab bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: The builders say they **will have finished** the roof by Friday.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilarning aytishicha, juma kunigacha tomni **bitkazib bo'lishadi**.

sentences.text: Next June I**'ll have been working** here for exactly ten years.
sentences.translation: Kelasi iyunda shu yerda **ishlayotganimga** roppa-rosa o'n yil bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Dad **will be going** to the bazaar tomorrow anyway, so he can buy the melons.
sentences.translation: Dadam ertaga baribir bozorga **boradi**, qovunlarni o'sha olib keladi.

sentences.text: By the time you get home, the kids **will have gone** to bed.
sentences.translation: Sen uyga yetib kelguningcha bolalar **yotib qolgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: In a few minutes the plane **will be landing**, so please fasten your seat belts.
sentences.translation: Bir necha daqiqadan keyin samolyot **qo'na boshlaydi**, iltimos, xavfsizlik kamarlaringizni taqing.

sentences.text: **Will** they **have finished** the repairs before the wedding? — I really hope so.
sentences.translation: To'ygacha ta'mirni **tugatib bo'lishadimi**? — Shunday bo'lishini juda umid qilaman.

examples.title: Time clauses: **when I get**, **once I've finished**
examples.description: when, as soon as, before, after, until, once, if, unless dan keyin kelajak ma'nosida Present Simple yoki Present Perfect keladi, will emas. if = whether bo'lsa — will mumkin.

sentences.text: I'll text you as soon as the plane **lands** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Samolyot Toshkentga **qo'nishi bilan** senga xabar yozaman.

sentences.text: We won't start dinner until Dad **gets** home from work.
sentences.translation: Dadam ishdan **kelmaguncha** kechki ovqatni boshlamaymiz.

sentences.text: Once you**'ve tried** Fergana apricots, you won't want any others.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona o'rigini bir **tatib ko'rsangiz**, boshqasini xohlamay qo'yasiz.

sentences.text: If it **rains** tomorrow, the football match will be postponed.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir **yog'sa**, futbol o'yini qoldiriladi.

sentences.text: Can I borrow that book when you**'ve finished** with it?
sentences.translation: Kitobni **o'qib bo'lganingizdan keyin** olib tursam maylimi?

sentences.text: Before you **leave** the office, please switch off all the computers.
sentences.translation: Ofisdan **ketishdan oldin** barcha kompyuterlarni o'chiring, iltimos.

sentences.text: Unless the price **comes** down, we'll have to look for another supplier.
sentences.translation: Narx **tushmasa**, boshqa yetkazib beruvchi izlashimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: I'm not sure if Rustam **will come**, but I'll ask him.
sentences.translation: Rustam **kelish-kelmasligini** bilmayman, lekin undan so'rab ko'raman.

sentences.text: After I **graduate**, I'm going to work in my father's company for a year.
sentences.translation: **O'qishni bitirganimdan keyin** bir yil otamning kompaniyasida ishlamoqchiman.

sentences.text: Call me the moment you **hear** any news about the results.
sentences.translation: Natijalar haqida biror xabar **eshitishingiz bilan** menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

examples.title: How sure? **about to**, **bound to**, **likely to**, **might**
examples.description: Kelajakning yaqinligi va ehtimollik darajasi: be about to (hozir-hozir), be bound to / be sure to (aniq), be likely to (ehtimoli katta), may / might / could (balki), be unlikely to (ehtimoli kam).

sentences.text: Hurry up and get in — the train **is about to leave**!
sentences.translation: Tez chiq — poyezd hozir **jo'nab ketadi**!

sentences.text: Shh, the baby**'s about to fall** asleep, so don't make a noise.
sentences.translation: Jim, chaqaloq **uxlab qolay deb turibdi**, shovqin qilma.

sentences.text: Don't lend him your camera — he**'s bound to break** it.
sentences.translation: Unga fotoapparatingni berma — **albatta sindiradi**.

sentences.text: With all this traffic, we**'re sure to be** late for the wedding.
sentences.translation: Bunaqa tirbandlikda to'yga **albatta kechikamiz**.

sentences.text: Interest rates **are likely to fall** later this year, experts say.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, foiz stavkalari shu yil oxirida **tushishi ehtimoli katta**.

sentences.text: Take an umbrella; it **might rain** later this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Soyabon olib ol, tushdan keyin yomg'ir **yog'ishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Nigora **may not get** the job, but she has a good chance.
sentences.translation: Nigorani bu ishga **olmasliklari mumkin**, lekin imkoniyati yaxshi.

sentences.text: The repairs **are unlikely to be** finished before winter.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir qishgacha **tugashi dargumon**.

sentences.text: Sooner or later, robots **will** probably **replace** many cashiers.
sentences.translation: Ertami-kechmi robotlar ko'plab kassirlarning o'rnini **egallasa kerak**.

sentences.text: **Could** this storm **cause** problems for flights tomorrow? — It **could** well.
sentences.translation: Bu bo'ron ertangi reyslarga muammo **tug'dirishi mumkinmi**? — Juda **mumkin**.

examples.title: Plans that changed: **was going to**, **would**, **was about to**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi kelajak: was going to (niyat bor edi, lekin...), was about to (endi ... qilay deb turgan edim), would (o'tmishdan qaraganda kelajak), was supposed to (... kerak edi).

sentences.text: We **were going to drive** to Bukhara, but the car broke down.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga mashinada **bormoqchi edik**, lekin mashina buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: I **was about to leave** the house when the phone rang.
sentences.translation: Uydan endi **chiqay deb turganimda** telefon jiringladi.

sentences.text: Back in 2015 nobody knew that this little café **would become** so famous.
sentences.translation: 2015-yilda bu kichkina kafe shunchalik mashhur **bo'lib ketishini** hech kim bilmasdi.

sentences.text: Sanjar **was meeting** his cousin at the airport, so he left work early.
sentences.translation: Sanjar aeroportda amakivachchasini **kutib olishi kerak edi**, shuning uchun ishdan erta chiqdi.

sentences.text: I thought it **was going to be** a boring lecture, but it was fascinating.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza zerikarli **bo'ladi deb o'ylagandim**, lekin juda qiziqarli chiqdi.

sentences.text: She promised she **would call** me back, but she never did.
sentences.translation: U menga qayta qo'ng'iroq **qilishini** va'da qilgandi, lekin qilmadi.

sentences.text: The match **was to have been** played on Sunday, but it was cancelled because of snow.
sentences.translation: O'yin yakshanba kuni **o'tkazilishi kerak edi**, lekin qor tufayli bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: Weren't you **going to fix** that tap last weekend? — Sorry, I forgot.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari o'sha jo'mrakni **tuzatmoqchi emasmiding**? — Kechir, esimdan chiqibdi.

sentences.text: When I started university, I had no idea that I **would end up** working in TV.
sentences.translation: Universitetga kirganimda oxir-oqibat televideniyeda **ishlab qolishimni** xayolimga ham keltirmagandim.

sentences.text: The parcel **was supposed to arrive** on Monday, but it's Thursday and still nothing.
sentences.translation: Posilka dushanba kuni **kelishi kerak edi**, lekin bugun payshanba, hali ham yo'q.
